text:
Maya R: quick sanity check before we mark halcyon14b ready for onboarding — weights are in s3://redwood-models/halcyon14b/v1/ as safetensors, split into TP=2 shards. intended dtype=fp16 with bf16 fallback (config shows "dtype": "fp16"). checksum uploaded: sha256:4f8c3e2b9a7d1f6c9b2e4a9f6d7c8b1a. CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/halcyon14b/123 — want green on packaging smoke and tokenizer lint before we promote. any red flags? :eyes:

Ravi S: I'll validate shard ordering + KV cache layout. quick question — was the tensor-parallel split done along the last dimension or the first? that changes the reshape we use in the runtime.

Ava P: fyi tokenizer.json missing the `<|bos|>` mapping we usually add for chat models. small patch to insert in repo:```diff
- "special_tokens": {"eos_token": "", "unk_token": ""}
+ "special_tokens": {"bos_token": "<|bos|>", "eos_token": "", "unk_token": ""}
``` should be fine but pinging @Ravi S because tokenizer byte offsets might affect tokenization tests.

Ravi S: thanks @Ava P. i'll run tokenization roundtrip and also confirm the TP split. if split is last-dim we need to set `tp_layout: [1,0]` in serving config — can someone paste current config?

Maya R: config snippet from s3:```json
{
  "model_type": "causal_lm",
  "dtype": "fp16",
  "safetensors": true,
  "shard_layout": "tp_lastdim:2",
  "tokenizer": "halcyon-tokenizer-v2"
}
``` note: shard names are halcyon_00.safetensors and halcyon_01.safetensors.

ci-bot: Packaging smoke job #123 started by Maya R — running convert/pack/lint steps. Current step: tokenizer-lint.

Jorge L: ran a quick smokeserve on a small input, saw a KV order warning then an OOM on 8GB GPU when batch=2 with TP=2 config. logs:```
[WARN] kv-cache: shard mismatch detected for layer 12
[ERROR] cuda: out of memory while allocating 1.2GiB for attention_k
``` might be an ordering mismatch between how we saved KV buffers and runtime expectation.

Ravi S: that lines up with last-dim split — conversion tool expected first-dim. i'll re-run the conversion with `--tp-layout last` and generate a new shardmap. referencing convert command used: `python convert.py --model halcyon --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --out s3://redwood-models/halcyon14b/v1/` — if we rerun with `--tp-layout last` it should fix the KV ordering.

Ava P: re: bf16 fallback — runtime will accept bf16 if fp16 kernels unavailable, but we should add `quant_fallback: ["bf16"]` to packaging config to make it explicit. small patch ready.

deploy-bot: created artifact halcyon14b/v1/packaging/halcyon14b-20260301-rc1.tar (size 12.3GB) — status: staging.

Ravi S: i've kicked a re-conversion (will overwrite shards) with `--tp-layout last` and added the tokenizer patch. running token roundtrip + unit tests (should be ~10m). will post checksums after.

ci-bot: tokenizer-lint failed: missing bos_token.

Maya R: thanks all. action items: @Ravi S re-convert + post new sha256, @Ava P add `quant_fallback` patch to PR, @Jorge L re-run smokeserve once conversion done. i'll hold promotion until CI passes. target promoter window: tomorrow 09:00 PST. :calendar:

Ravi S: update — conversion finished, new shards uploaded, new checksum sha256:7b9e2a1d5c6f3a4b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d. token roundtrip ok (0 mismatches). running smokeserve now.

Jorge L: smokeserve success with TP=2, batch=2 on 16GB GPU. no kv warnings. sample output looks good.

ci-bot: packaging smoke job #123 succeeded. all checks green.

Maya R: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll start the onboarding checklist and schedule the canary tomorrow morning. :rocket:
